name: floating_on_dreams
description: glossy glass: the smooth count lit as ring tubes with near-white highlights, every bulb a ringed glass dome with a glowing centre, light threads over it and a faint checker in the pale field
reuses: field smooth: the outside palette position and the outside light's height
the leveled spend (Spend::of) with the rank transfer, so every frame spends the map evenly
field threads (the accumulated cross trap): the light streaks
field decomposition (the escape angle): the checker's sectors
the spec palette's mirror bake and rolloff
adds: the style compositor (engine/src/style.rs) and the render spec's style key
channel gradient: the unit direction the smooth count climbs, from dz/z at the escape
channel inside: a smooth convergence count inside the set, with its own gradient
layer light: a ring-banded height lit Blinn-Phong with a rim, on a channel's gradient
layer glow: a channel's position as the alpha of a colour under a blend
layer pattern: a checker of escape bands by escape-angle sectors
mask: any channel as an extra alpha on a layer
